## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly supported by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235].
- claim-2: Correctly supported by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735]. This establishes the antipode/Hopf identity, not the requested equality in \(Q\).
- claim-3: Correctly supported by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840]. That passage states only the right-adjoined generating set and a prospective transposed argument.
- claim-4: The bounded relevant passages omit the signed equality, but a complete-source omission audit was not supplied. More importantly, the mathematical certificate remains unestablished: no map is defined that converts the accepted full-coordinate \(\operatorname{Lin}_\varphi\)-row identity into
  \[
  \bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}-(-1)^{|\rho|}\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}\in A_+J_v.
  \]
  The graded-kernel presentation proves independence of the lower-adjoined classes but does not determine the coordinates of the right-adjoined class. The finite \((2,3,2,2)\) computation cannot prove the universal assertion.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] For every \(\rho\subseteq b^a\), explicitly construct homogeneous \(F_{\rho,\sigma}\in A_{|\rho|-|\sigma|}\) such that
  \[
  \bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}-(-1)^{|\rho|}\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}
  =\sum_{\sigma\subsetneq\rho}F_{\rho,\sigma}\bar s_{(i^j,\sigma)}
  \]
  in \(A\), deriving every coefficient term-by-term from the accepted full-coordinate Hopf identity.
- [computation] As auxiliary evidence only, provide complete ordered relation matrices and integral row witnesses
  \[
  z_\rho M=e_{L_\rho}-(-1)^{|\rho|}e_{R_\rho}
  \]
  for a new nontrivial specialization; explicitly state that this finite witness does not establish the universal equation.
- [source-refresh] Either supply a bounded passage stating the exact signed equality in \(Q\), or perform a complete fixed-literal/formula audit of the inspected full text (SHA-256 `267a2f5eeae54137af99793e84d5293ec688e854ffff662ddd3a27b1334e2bbd`) and report its absence. Include [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 667-700] and [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840], distinguishing the tensor reduction formula from the requested quotient equality.

## Required revisions
- State all padding conventions, including omission of \(i^0\) when \(b=j\), and handle \(\rho=\varnothing\) and \(a=0\).
- Replace the unsupported implication from Hopf descent to rectangular straightening with an explicit derivation.
- Conclude that the scoped certificate is presently unresolved; do not claim the parent theorem.
